applies_why: No: the judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness and instead says the matter was answered.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge identifies the matter as answered in [CR2] and [CR3], K-G4 expressly excludes it from being counted as an unanswered witness, and no other verse is counted that way.
